entry.author: Sport New Zealand Ihi Aotearoa
entry.summary: Peter Harrison Managing Director - Think Place, Kataraina Davis (Ngāti Whātua, Ngāti Kahu) – Founder – Tuakana Teina Tōtika and Chief Advisor Māori, Heart FoundationDay 1 looked at the big picture and the opportunities ahead. This keynote focuses on what to do next. How do we turn ideas into action? Drawing on experience in design thinking and innovation, Peter and Kataraina share practical ways leaders can work together, make clear choices and create real impact.
